items.stem:
An auto-rickshaw in Nagpur charges a fixed ₹50 plus ₹15 per km. Varun models the fare as f(x) = 50 + 15x for a ride of x km.
(i) Find f(8). (ii) What is the domain of f in this context? (iii) For what distance is the fare ₹230? (iv) Is f a linear function? Give its slope.
items.answer: (i) ₹170 (ii) x ≥ 0 (non-negative real numbers) (iii) 12 km (iv) yes, slope 15
items.markingKey: (i) substitute (1). (ii) distance cannot be negative (1). (iii) solve a + bx = fare (1). (iv) f(x) = mx + c with m = b (1).

items.stem: Let A = {1, 5, 6, 9, 12}. Define R on A by R = {(a, b) : a, b ∈ A, b is exactly divisible by a, a ≠ b}. Write R in roster form and find its domain and range.
items.markingKey: Check every ordered pair (2); read off first and second components (1).

items.stem: If A = {p, q} and B = {x, y, z}, write A × B. Is A × B = B × A?
items.markingKey: A × B = {(p, x), (p, y), (p, z), (q, x), (q, y), (q, z)} (1); B × A contains (x, p) ≠ (p, x), so not equal (1).

items.stem: Find the domain of the real function f(x) = (x² + 6)/(x² − 11x + 30).
items.markingKey: Denominator x² − 11x + 30 = (x − 5)(x − 6) = 0 at x = 5, 6 (1); exclude them (1).

items.stem: R = {(x, y) : y = 3x + 4, x ∈ {4, 5, 7, 9}}. Write R in roster form and find its domain and range.
items.markingKey: Substitute each x (1); domain = set of first elements (1); range = set of second elements (1).
